data.one_liner: Analyzer-independent lint presets with Altive's recommended rule selection and optional Analyzer Plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized lint rule presets and an optional analyzer plugin with specific code-style and architectural rules tailored by Altive. It helps enforce best practices, avoid common Flutter anti-patterns, and includes code assists for documentation.
use_when: You want to enforce Altive's recommended lint rule selections in your Flutter project.
You need custom analyzer diagnostics and assists for Flutter architectures.
You want analyzer-independent lint presets that work cleanly across recent Dart and Flutter versions.
avoid_when: You prefer standard official lints without custom team rule presets.
You cannot use analyzer plugins or custom lint packages in your environment.
strengths: Includes helpful custom rules like avoid_hardcoded_color and prefer_clock_now.
Analyzer-independent YAML presets avoid version conflicts with test dependencies.
Provides quick fixes and documentation assists.
weaknesses: Requires configuration in analysis_options.yaml and specific plugin settings.
Some recommended rules may be too opinionated for certain codebases.
data.setup_notes: Add altive_lints to dev_dependencies and include package:altive_lints/altive_lints.yaml in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer official Flutter team recommended lints over third-party opinionated presets.
